3b5(rgyud): gos bgos par gyur/sems can bkres pa dag ni lto 'grangs par gyur/sems can skom pa dag ni skom ngoms par gyur/sems can nad kyis btab pa dag ni nad dang bral bar gyur/lus kyi dbang po nyams pa dag

3b7(rgyud): de tshim zhing mgu la yid rangs shing rab tu dga' ste/dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/de dag ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/sangs rgyas bcom lda 'das de dag rnam 
3b8(rgyud): par rjes su dran la/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i yon tan rjes su dran zhing /bcom ldan 'das shAkya thab pa'i sku tshe'i tshad la the tshom za bar gyur te/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thob pa 'di ltar lo brgyad bcu zhig 
4a1(rgyud): thub ste sku tshe thung ba 'di ji lta bu/'di ci zhig snyam du bsam pa de sems shing 'dug par gyur to//de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis dgongs shing mkhyen bzhin du/byang chub sems dpa' mdzes 
4a2(rgyud): pa'i tog la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//rigs kyi bu khyod 'di snyam du/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa 'di ltar sku tshe thung ngo snyam du ma sems shig/de ci'i phyir zhe na/rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 
4a3(rgyud): dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ma gtogs par/lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang bdud dang bcas pa dang tshangs pa dang dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na/
4a4(rgyud): bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shAkya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad kyi mtha'/phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bar du yang rtogs par nus pa ded kyis su yang ma mthong ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/de dag gis de bzhin gshegs 
4a5(rgyud): pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bshad pa brjod ma thag tu/de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus/lha'i bu 'dod pa na spyod pa rnams dang gzugs na spyod pa rnams dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci
